description: This source file contains a set of accessibility tests focusing on name computation (accname) for various HTML form elements and labels, including input elements with different attributes and associations, fieldsets, tables, and images. It includes references to test harness scripts and contains test data attributes for expected labels.

methods.name: AriaUtils.verifyLabelsBySelector
methods.description: A function call to verify labels for elements matching a specified selector, used for testing label accessibility and correctness.
